clue.text: Spurge regularly understood by a few to be grass

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word spurge, starting with the first

parts.note: arcane knowledge is known only to a few initiates

explanation.surface: A botanist muses that a weedy spurge is, to the few in the know, really a kind of grass.
explanation.definitionFit: The tall sweet plant grown for sugar is a member of the grass family.

clue.text: Disposed of holding in one firm

indicators.note: holding in means the word for disposed of keeps the other letter inside it

parts.note: goods disposed of have been sold
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Something got rid of while keeping a stake in a single company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'firm' looks like a company noun; it is the adjective meaning hard or steady.
explanation.definitionFit: Firm and hard both describe something that does not give under pressure.

clue.text: Caught out hoarding narrow material now superseded by plastic

indicators.note: hoarding means the anagram keeps the other piece stored inside it
out means the letters of caught are put out of order

parts.note: to taper is to narrow, used as a verb

explanation.surface: Someone is caught out stockpiling a thin material that plastics have since replaced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'narrow' is a verb here, to taper, not an adjective describing the material.
explanation.definitionFit: This latex from Malaysian trees was once used to insulate cables and make golf balls before modern plastics.

clue.text: A break is good in itself, to acquire energy

indicators.note: to acquire means the energy letter is added on at the end
in itself means the break holds the word for good within its own letters

parts.note: a rest is a break
pi, short for pious, means good

explanation.surface: A holiday is a good thing in its own right, a way to recharge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A break' does double duty: it is the definition and also gives REST, which holds PI.
explanation.definitionFit: A pause or interval of relief from effort is a short rest.

clue.text: Likes something to download on travels

parts.note: an app is a program downloaded to a phone
roves means wanders or travels

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys a downloadable program while on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: To like something is to think well of it, to endorse or favour it.

clue.text: Employee always receives a service

indicators.note: receives means the word for always takes the other pieces into it

parts.note: e'er is the poetic short form of ever, meaning always
RN is the Royal Navy, one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A worker is forever taking in a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in paid work makes a wage, so a worker is a wage-maker.

clue.text: A rainbow coalition's 'leader returned for city

indicators.note: the leader of the coalition is its first letter
returned means the word for a rainbow is written backwards

parts.note: a rainbow forms an arc across the sky

explanation.surface: A political rainbow coalition's leader comes back to take charge of a city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' sits after the coalition's leader but turns only the rainbow's word.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Ghana is a West African city on the coast.

clue.text: Sound of explosion unresolved, drunkard may declare

indicators.note: a drunk slurring words would say the phrase with a slushy sh sound

parts.note: a matter still unresolved is at issue

explanation.surface: A noisy blast remains unexplained, says a tipsy witness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at issue', slurred by a drunk, comes out as the sneeze noise; the explosion is a sneeze.
explanation.definitionFit: The noise of a sneeze, a sudden nasal explosion, is written this way.

clue.text: Feature of mountain, no end of wintry conditions?

indicators.note: no end of means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: cold weather is what winter brings

explanation.surface: A mountain has endless wintry weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no end of' looks like 'lots of', but it removes the last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A pass or low point between two peaks on a ridge is a mountain landform.

clue.text: Through small error, I smash into drivers in the country

indicators.note: smash into says the pieces crash inside the drivers' organisation

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British motoring organisation
by means through, as in by means of
a sin is a moral error

explanation.surface: A minor slip leads someone to crash into other motorists in some country.
explanation.definitionFit: The old name for Ethiopia was used for that African nation until the mid twentieth century.

clue.text: Many maintain initially uncomfortable position

indicators.note: to maintain is to hold, so the word for many holds the other letter inside it

parts.note: lots means many

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of uncomfortable

explanation.surface: Plenty of people insist that a certain pose is awkward to hold.
explanation.definitionFit: A cross-legged seated posture in yoga is named after the water lily.

clue.text: Roman poet heading 'off has to travel round a bit

indicators.note: round means the word for travel goes around the other piece

parts.note: to ply is to travel regularly back and forth, as a ferry plies

indicators.note: heading off removes the first letter of the poet's name

explanation.walkthrough: Martial was a first-century Roman writer of satirical epigrams.

clue.text: Cut back to finish self-portrait as a bit of a devil?

definitions.meaning: to retrench, reducing spending or ambitions

definitions.text: to finish self-portrait as a bit of a devil?
definitions.meaning: an artist painting himself as a devil would complete the picture by sketching the pair of points on his head

explanation.surface: An artist cuts short work on a self-portrait that shows him as something of a devil.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom, from a snail pulling in its feelers, means to economise or become less ambitious.

clue.text: Flying, oddly doubt beginner will identify it

definitions.text: Flying, oddly doubt beginner will identify it

indicators.note: flying means the letters fly about and land in a new order
oddly takes the odd-numbered letters of doubt

explanation.surface: A novice birdwatcher is unlikely to recognise this bird in flight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' picks DUT from DOUBT; with BEGINNER that is rearranged. The whole clue also hints that a beginner would struggle to name this bird flying.
explanation.definitionFit: This brown sparrow-like bird of reed beds is hard for novices to tell apart in flight.

clue.text: Gardens in dry period finally got ready for barbecue?

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of period

explanation.walkthrough: KEW is the famous botanical garden in south-west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Food is threaded on spits before going over the coals, so pierced pieces are prepared for grilling.

clue.text: Old beast rises to appeal, in our case

SA is sex appeal

explanation.walkthrough: 'rises' means gets up: in a down clue, GETS read upward gives STEG.

clue.text: Somehow make or mend to be in fashion

clue.text: Cease to convince with clothing advice for warm weather?

in heat one is told to put on light garments

clue.text: Remove former pupils and more from conversation

explanation.surface: Taking out ex-students and others when talking.
explanation.walkthrough: EX plus EYES, said together, sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut something out, as a surgeon does, is to take it away.

clue.text: Shady area where assistant introduces additive, one European banned

clue.text: I'm not sure bad boys should get top grade for nothing, going for high marks in German

A is the top grade in exams

clue.text: Refuse to accept husband in party

parts.note: trash is refuse, rubbish

explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like a verb; it is the noun meaning rubbish.

clue.text: A note put out describing perhaps his scheme as crazy
